{{Top|leg}}
A '''tunnel-tube''' was an element of a [[tunnel-tube junction station]]. There where four tubes to a station. They consisted of a pleated skin over a servoframe, and extended from the junction station. The tubes contained a hatch-mounted mouth which could dock with other junction stations, [[Starship/Legends|starships]], or building hatches. Each tube had an airtight iris-hatch at its end. Tunnel-tubes also had [[Viewport/Legends|viewports]] mounted in their sides.
